system.description:
+3 to Security and Computer checks; on a success the lock or computer is destroyed (doors stay open, data is lost). Installed into an existing cybernetic. After a successful Fighting attack on a drone or robot, roll D10 + Cyber bonus against D10 + the drone controller's Cyber bonus (or the robot's To Hit): higher deactivates it. Illegal.

Espionage Supplement
